headline: 12kg LPG cylinder price rises by Tk 252 to Tk 1,837
summary: The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) has increased the price of LPG cylinders and auto-gas, adding to consumer burdens.
details: The price of a 12kg LPG cylinder has been increased by Tk 252, bringing the new official price to Tk 1,837. The decision was made by the Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) on Sunday, October 4.
Previously, the official price of a 12kg cylinder was Tk 1,585. However, consumers have already been paying nearly Tk 2,000 at the retail level in the market.
In September, the price had been slightly reduced by Tk 13 to Tk 1,585, while the price before that was Tk 1,598.
Additionally, the price of auto-gas used in vehicles has been increased by Tk 11 per liter, setting the new price at Tk 84.62 per liter.
caption:
LPG prices jump by Tk 252! Official rates rise, but consumers are already paying far more in the market.

The price of a 12kg LPG cylinder has been increased by Tk 252, bringing the new official price to Tk 1,837. The decision was made by the Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) on Sunday, October 4.

Previously, the official price of a 12kg cylinder was Tk 1,585. However, consumers have already been paying nearly Tk 2,000 at the retail level in the market.

In September, the price had been slightly reduced by Tk 13 to Tk 1,585, while the price before that was Tk 1,598.

Additionally, the price of auto-gas used in vehicles has been increased by Tk 11 per liter, setting the new price at Tk 84.62 per liter.

#Bangladesh #LPGPrice #FuelHike #CostOfLiving #BERC

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com, The Daily Star

headline: Courtroom chaos: Jamaat leader Akhtaruzzaman denied bail, sent to jail
summary: A bail hearing for retired major Mohammad Akhtaruzzaman Ranjan erupted into a scuffle between lawyers in a Dhaka court.
details: A bail hearing for Jamaat-e-Islami leader retired major Mohammad Akhtaruzzaman Ranjan descended into a courtroom scuffle in Dhaka on Sunday.
The clash broke out between BNP- and Jamaat-backed lawyers over a dispute regarding where they could stand in the courtroom.
The situation became so tense that Metropolitan Magistrate Jamshed Alam was forced to leave for his chamber during the proceedings.
The scuffle was eventually settled after interventions by state counsel Omar Faruq Faruqi and defence lawyer Abdur Razzaq.
The hearing was for a case accusing Akhtaruzzaman of threatening the executive director of Shahjalal International Airport and assaulting a security supervisor.
Following the hearing, the court denied bail to the Jamaat leader and ordered him to be sent to jail.
caption:
A Dhaka courtroom erupted into chaos as lawyers clashed during the bail hearing of Jamaat leader Akhtaruzzaman.

A bail hearing for Jamaat-e-Islami leader retired major Mohammad Akhtaruzzaman Ranjan descended into a courtroom scuffle in Dhaka on Sunday.

The clash broke out between BNP- and Jamaat-backed lawyers over a dispute regarding where they could stand in the courtroom.

The situation became so tense that Metropolitan Magistrate Jamshed Alam was forced to leave for his chamber during the proceedings.

The scuffle was eventually settled after interventions by state counsel Omar Faruq Faruqi and defence lawyer Abdur Razzaq.

The hearing was for a case accusing Akhtaruzzaman of threatening the executive director of Shahjalal International Airport and assaulting a security supervisor.

Following the hearing, the court denied bail to the Jamaat leader and ordered him to be sent to jail.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #Jamaat #CourtNews #Politics

Source: Prothom Alo, bdnews24.com, Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star
